methodProvenance.confidenceFieldIsNotLoadBearing: Admission was decided structurally and from a source index of what the DS actually stamps, not from the scout grade. The double-census adjudication measured scout self-confidence at Cohen kappa 0.179 (REC-4).
methodProvenance.partAnchoringRule: R-8, decided from source: a part is admitted only where the DS stamps data-part with that name, or a DS component-identity class pair matches. Scout prose is corroboration, not authority.

rootAnchor.note: CONVENTION DIVERGENCE, measured not inferred: this is the ONLY family of the 36 whose root does not carry the tier pair `ds-surface ds-<family>`. The TSX root is `<div className="rottay-transition-root">` at index.tsx:512 and the skin keys on `.rottay-transition-root` at oauth-transition.css:17. Every class token in this family is spelled rottay-*, not ds-*. Consequence: any selector, gate or audit that finds surfaces by the `ds-surface` tier class misses this family entirely, which is a plausible reason its --rh-* defect (SF-1) survived as long as it did.

surfaceSkinBinding.law: A surface carries no CSS under `ui/surfaces/`. Its paint lives in a dedicated skin bound by the root pair plus BEM elements and data-part, so those class pairs are part anchors under RULING R-8 (b).

targetBinding.why: es la valvula de escape, no el modelo -- textual del canon: "escape hatch, not the model: every recurring override is a candidate for a real capability". Alcanza cualquier canal por construccion (allowlist cerrada, max 200, falla cerrado) y por eso no declara nada por familia.
targetBinding.instrument: un override recurrente sobre esta familia es EVIDENCIA de una capacidad faltante: convertilo en un control real, no lo normalices aqui

targetBinding.why: ningun componente ni superficie lee --ds-recipe-profile: la receta rebinds raices y el marcador vive en el :root del tema compilado; leerla directamente rompe la cascada (L4)

no necesita raiz propia: dependsOn=[experience.profile] y sus seis ejes sobrescriben por eje los MISMOS canales que ya componen las raices existentes. Los sockets de esta celda son los sockets de las raices mapeadas, no unos nuevos.

reasons.why: 0 lecturas de --ds-color-{success,warning,error,info}* en skin ni TSX; superficie de experiencia no compone tono de estado

targetBinding.why: el plano no porta iconos propios; los iconos viven en los componentes huesped

no emite ninguna variable CSS: declaredOutputs.channels esta vacio y el propio control lo declara -- la escalera viaja como DATO (document -> schema -> artifact normalizedAppearance) y llega a la geometria solo por la puerta 2 del solver (AdaptiveLayoutEnv.spanBias) y por el bucketing de postura de contenedor. Nunca un canal CSS, nunca una lectura de viewport.
targetBinding.reach: solo las familias que consumen el runtime de adaptive-layout, y por prop de JS, no por socket
